query.statement: SELECT UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE UI_ID = @uiId
SELECT UI_ID, TITLE FROM SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY UI_ID

MERGE SYS_SCREEN_DEFINITION WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @uiId AS UI_ID) AS s ON t.UI_ID = s.UI_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TITLE = @title, DEFINITION_JSON = @definitionJson, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UI_ID, TITLE, DEFINITION_JSON, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@uiId, @title, @definitionJson, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY ROLE_ID
SELECT ROLE_ID, ROLE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, PERMISSIONS FROM SYS_ROLE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ROLE_ID = @roleId AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, PROGRAM_ID, IMAGE_ID, OPTIONS, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, MENU_ID
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, ROLE_ID, LANGUAGE, IS_ACTIVE, LAST_LOGIN_AT FROM SYS_USER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@roleId IS NULL OR ROLE_ID = @roleId) ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_ID

SELECT m.MENU_ID, m.MENU_NAME, m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, m.MENU_TYPE, m.UI_ID FROM SYS_MENU m WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE m.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND ( m.MENU_TYPE <> 'Screen' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_MENU_ROLE r WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE r.MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID AND r.VALID_STATE = 'Valid') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_MENU_ROLE r WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN SYS_USER u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.USER_ID = @currentUser AND u.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE r.MENU_ID = m.MENU_ID AND r.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND r.ROLE_ID = u.ROLE_ID) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_USER u WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN SYS_ROLE ro WITH (NOLOCK) ON ro.ROLE_ID = u.ROLE_ID AND ro.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE u.USER_ID = @currentUser AND u.IS_DELETED = 0 AND ('|' + ro.PERMISSIONS + '|') LIKE '%|*|%') ) ORDER BY m.PARENT_MENU_ID, m.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, m.MENU_ID

SELECT r.MENU_ID, m.MENU_NAME, r.ROLE_ID, ro.ROLE_NAME, r.VALID_STATE FROM SYS_MENU_ROLE r WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN SYS_MENU m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.MENU_ID = r.MENU_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE ro WITH (NOLOCK) ON ro.ROLE_ID = r.ROLE_ID WHERE r.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY r.MENU_ID, r.ROLE_ID

MERGE SYS_MENU_ROLE WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @menuId AS MENU_ID, @roleId AS ROLE_ID) AS s ON t.MENU_ID = s.MENU_ID AND t.ROLE_ID = s.ROLE_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET VALID_STATE = 'Valid' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MENU_ID, ROLE_ID, VALID_STATE) VALUES (@menuId, @roleId, 'Valid');
DELETE FROM SYS_MENU_ROLE WHERE MENU_ID = @menuId AND ROLE_ID = @roleId
SELECT RESOURCE_KEY, VALUE FROM SYS_MULTI_LANGUAGE_RESOURCE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE LANGUAGE = @language
SELECT LANGUAGE FROM SYS_USER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND IS_DELETED = 0
UPDATE SYS_USER SET LANGUAGE = @language, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT F.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.PROGRAM_ID, M.IMAGE_ID, M.UI_ID, F.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU F WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN SYS_MENU M WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.MENU_ID = F.MENU_ID AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' WHERE F.USER_ID = @currentUser ORDER BY F.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, F.MENU_ID

INSERT INTO SYS_FAVORITE_MENU (USER_ID, MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, CREATED_AT) SELECT @currentUser, M.MENU_ID, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(F.DISPLAY_SEQUENCE) FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU F WHERE F.USER_ID = @currentUser), 0) + 1, @utcNow FROM SYS_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID = @menuId AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU F2 WHERE F2.USER_ID = @currentUser AND F2.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID)
DELETE FROM SYS_FAVORITE_MENU WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId
UPDATE SYS_FAVORITE_MENU SET DISPLAY_SEQUENCE = @sequence WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId

SELECT TOP 10 R.MENU_ID, M.MENU_NAME, M.PROGRAM_ID, M.IMAGE_ID, M.UI_ID, R.LAST_USED_AT FROM SYS_RECENT_MENU R WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN SYS_MENU M WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.MENU_ID = R.MENU_ID AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' WHERE R.USER_ID = @currentUser ORDER BY R.LAST_USED_AT DESC

MERGE SYS_RECENT_MENU WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING ( SELECT M.MENU_ID FROM SYS_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_ID = @menuId AND M.VALID_STATE = 'Valid' AND M.MENU_TYPE = 'Screen' ) AS s ON t.USER_ID = @currentUser AND t.MENU_ID = s.MENU_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET LAST_USED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, MENU_ID, LAST_USED_AT) VALUES (@currentUser, s.MENU_ID, @utcNow);
DELETE FROM SYS_RECENT_MENU WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID NOT IN ( SELECT TOP 10 MENU_ID FROM SYS_RECENT_MENU WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser ORDER BY LAST_USED_AT DESC)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EST_EQUIPMENT_ALARM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CLEARED_AT IS NULL) AS ACTIVE_ALARMS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS IN ('Issued','InProgress')) AS OPEN_WORK_ORDERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS IN ('Released','InProgress')) AS ACTIVE_PLANS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RMS_RECIPE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE APPROVAL_STATE IN ('WaitApproval','Approved1')) AS PENDING_RECIPE_APPROVALS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE STATUS IN ('Draft','Confirmed')) AS OPEN_DELIVERY_ORDERS

SELECT BATCH_ID, BATCH_NAME, BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_RULE, BATCH_OPTIONS, BATCH_INPUTDATA, AUTO_TRANSACTION, SAVE_HISTORY, DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM SYS_BATCH_PROCESS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE VALID_STATE = 'Valid' ORDER BY BATCH_NAME, BATCH_ID

MERGE SYS_BATCH_PROCESS WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @batchId AS BATCH_ID) AS s ON t.BATCH_ID = s.BATCH_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET BATCH_NAME = @batchName, BATCH_TYPE = @batchType, BATCH_RULE = @batchRule, BATCH_OPTIONS = @batchOptions, BATCH_INPUTDATA = @batchInputData, DESCRIPTION = @description, VALID_STATE = 'Valid', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BATCH_ID, BATCH_NAME, BATCH_TYPE, BATCH_RULE, BATCH_OPTIONS, BATCH_INPUTDATA, DESCRIPTION, VALID_STATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@batchId, @batchName, @batchType, @batchRule, @batchOptions, @batchInputData, @description, 'Valid', @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
UPDATE SYS_BATCH_PROCESS SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE BATCH_ID = @batchId

INSERT INTO SYS_BATCH_PROCESS_HISTORY (HISTORY_ID, BATCH_ID, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, SUCCESS, AFFECTED, ERROR_MESSAGE, EXECUTED_BY) VALUES (@historyId, @batchId, @startedAt, @finishedAt, @success, @affected, @errorMessage, @currentUser)

SELECT TOP 200 HISTORY_ID, BATCH_ID, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, SUCCESS, AFFECTED, ERROR_MESSAGE, EXECUTED_BY FROM SYS_BATCH_PROCESS_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@batchId IS NULL OR BATCH_ID = @batchId) ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC
DELETE FROM SYS_APP_LOG WHERE LOGGED_AT < DATEADD(DAY, -@retentionDays, @utcNow)
DELETE FROM SYS_REQUEST_LOG WHERE REQUESTED_AT < DATEADD(DAY, -@retentionDays, @utcNow)
SELECT NAME, SAVED_AT, VALUES_JSON FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId ORDER BY SAVED_AT DESC

MERGE SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @currentUser AS USER_ID, @menuId AS MENU_ID, @name AS NAME) AS s ON t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND t.MENU_ID = s.MENU_ID AND t.NAME = s.NAME WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SAVED_AT = @utcNow, VALUES_JSON = @valuesJson WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, MENU_ID, NAME, SAVED_AT, VALUES_JSON) VALUES (@currentUser, @menuId, @name, @utcNow, @valuesJson);
DELETE FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId AND NAME = @name

DELETE FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId AND NAME <> '$latest' AND NAME NOT IN ( SELECT TOP 10 NAME FROM SYS_CONDITION_SETTING WHERE USER_ID = @currentUser AND MENU_ID = @menuId AND NAME <> '$latest' ORDER BY SAVED_AT DESC)

MERGE SYS_MENU WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING (SELECT @menuId AS MENU_ID) AS s ON t.MENU_ID = s.MENU_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET MENU_NAME = @menuName, PARENT_MENU_ID = @parentMenuId, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE = @displaySequence, MENU_TYPE = @menuType, UI_ID = @uiId, VALID_STATE = 'Valid' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MENU_ID, MENU_NAME, PARENT_MENU_ID, DISPLAY_SEQUENCE, MENU_TYPE, UI_ID, VALID_STATE) VALUES (@menuId, @menuName, @parentMenuId, @displaySequence, @menuType, @uiId, 'Valid');
UPDATE SYS_MENU SET VALID_STATE = 'Invalid' WHERE MENU_ID = @menuId
SELECT NOTICE_ID, TITLE, NOTICE_TYPE, POSTED_BY, POSTED_AT, IS_ACTIVE FROM SYS_NOTICE WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY POSTED_AT DESC
SELECT MSG_CLASS_ID, MSG_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM SYS_MESSAGE_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY MSG_CLASS_NAME
SELECT MSG_ID, MSG_CLASS_ID, MSG_CODE, MSG_TEXT, LANGUAGE FROM SYS_MESSAGE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@msgClassId IS NULL OR MSG_CLASS_ID = @msgClassId) ORDER BY MSG_CODE
SELECT LANG_CLASS_ID, LANG_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM SYS_LANGUAGE_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY LANG_CLASS_NAME
SELECT I18N_ID, LANG_CLASS_ID, MESSAGE_KEY, LANGUAGE, TRANSLATION FROM SYS_I18N WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY MESSAGE_KEY
SELECT RULE_ID, RULE_NAME, RULE_TYPE, IS_ACTIVE, DESCRIPTION FROM SYS_RULE WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY RULE_NAME
SELECT FILE_ID, VERSION, FILE_NAME, FILE_SIZE, DESCRIPTION, FORCE_UPDATE, IS_ACTIVE, UPLOADED_BY, UPLOADED_AT FROM SYS_DEPLOY_FILE WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY UPLOADED_AT DESC

SELECT LOG_ID, METHOD, PATH, STATUS_CODE, ELAPSED_MS, USER_ID, CLIENT_IP, REQUESTED_AT FROM SYS_REQUEST_LOG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@method IS NULL OR METHOD = @method) AND (@userId IS NULL OR USER_ID = @userId) ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT DESC OFFSET (SELECT ISNULL(@offset, 0)) ROWS FETCH NEXT (SELECT ISNULL(@limit, 500)) ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM SYS_REQUEST_LOG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@method IS NULL OR METHOD = @method) AND (@userId IS NULL OR USER_ID = @userId)

SELECT LOG_ID, LOG_LEVEL, CATEGORY, MESSAGE, EXCEPTION, LOGGED_AT FROM SYS_APP_LOG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@logLevel IS NULL OR LOG_LEVEL = @logLevel) ORDER BY LOGGED_AT DESC OFFSET (SELECT ISNULL(@offset, 0)) ROWS FETCH NEXT (SELECT ISNULL(@limit, 500)) ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM SYS_APP_LOG WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@logLevel IS NULL OR LOG_LEVEL = @logLevel)

SELECT FORMAT(LOGGED_AT, 'HH:00') AS HOUR_LABEL, COUNT(*) AS LOG_COUNT FROM SYS_APP_LOG WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY FORMAT(LOGGED_AT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH'), FORMAT(LOGGED_AT, 'HH:00') ORDER BY FORMAT(LOGGED_AT, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH') ASC
